# Eshwar Home Products

Eshwar Home Products is a neighbourhood food and pantry store in Perambur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Store identity
- English name: Eshwar Home Products
- Tamil name: ஈஸ்வர் ஹோம் புராடக்ட்ஸ்
- Website: https://eshwar-home-products.vercel.app/
- Address: 119/1, Paddy Field Rd, Chinnaiyan Colony, Perambur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600011, India
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Eshwar+Home+Products/@13.1118547,80.2468127,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x3a526569af8122ad:0xe485caf4b8adf074!8m2!3d13.1118495!4d80.2493876!16s%2Fg%2F11v4j6lc03?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MTExNS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D

## Opening hours
- Monday–Saturday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Store offerings
The store catalogue describes these categories and selections:
- Traditional rice varieties
- Millets and millet flours (Siruthaniyam)
- Flakes, vermicelli and pasta
- Cold-pressed oils, including gingelly, groundnut and coconut
- Ghee and dairy essentials
- Honey, pulses, dry fruits, nuts and more
- Sathumaavu (traditional mix)
- Mudavattukal Kilangu

The catalogue is a guide to product categories, not a live stock guarantee. Specific varieties, pack sizes, prices and availability may change. Customers should contact the store to confirm current details before visiting.
